embed.title: !enable (admin)
embed.description: Turn a disabled user, channel or webhook back on — whether it was disabled by `{{prefix}}disable`, for losing a role, or for going over the alert limit.

fields.name: Usage
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}enable <id>` — by ID
{{#if isDiscord}}`{{prefix}}enable @user` — by mention
{{/if}}`{{prefix}}enable <id> <id>` — several at once
`{{prefix}}enable mywebhook` — a webhook, by name

Give bare IDs: `{{prefix}}enable user:<id>` doesn't work. IDs that aren't registered are listed in the reply.

fields.name: What it does
fields.value: Clears the disable, turns alerts back on (as `{{prefix}}start` would), and resets the delivery-failure count and rate-limit ban history. Tracking is unchanged.

fields.name: Related
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}help disable` — disable a user
`{{prefix}}help userlist` — find IDs and see who is disabled
